name: t3code
one_liner: A remote control for the AI coding assistants already running on your computer — a mobile app, web app, and desktop app that let you check on and steer Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor from your phone instead of staring at a terminal all day.
buyer: A developer who already pays for Claude Code or Codex and wants to kick off and babysit long-running coding tasks from their phone while away from their desk.
business_use_cases: A solo developer starts a long refactor before leaving for lunch and approves or redirects it from their phone instead of sitting at the keyboard.
A technical founder reviews and approves AI agent actions from a hotel room during travel without needing a laptop open.
A small dev team uses it as a lightweight shared dashboard to see what every teammate's AI agent is currently doing across machines.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted team tier with shared visibility, permissions, and audit history across a company's developers.
Paid push-notification/alerting add-ons for specific failure or completion events.

steal_this: It's free and open already — the fastest weekend move is building a narrow companion: a Slack/Discord bridge that posts agent status updates into a team channel.
